newsitem.title: UK: AMERADA HESS STARTS UK DURWARD, DAUNTLESS FIELDS.
newsitem.headline: AMERADA HESS STARTS UK DURWARD, DAUNTLESS FIELDS.

text.p: Amerada Hess said on Monday it had started up the Durward and Dauntless oilfields that it operates in the British sector of the North Sea.
Peak production at Durward is expected to be 38,000 barrels per day (bpd), and 10,000 bpd at Dauntless, industry sources estimated.
Amerada Hess said the discoveries were being produced in parallel, using a floating production and storage vessel permanently moored over the fields.
Durward was discovered in October 1993 in Block 21/16 while Dauntless was found in Block 21/11 in December 1994, the company added.
The two are located 140 km (90 miles) from Aberdeen in the central North Sea, with Dauntless some seven km (four miles) northwest of the Durward field.
